---
name: Pilot integration feedback
about: Report an authorized integration test or reproducible defect
---

## What you tested

Registration, authentication, recovery rotation, revocation, or mutual handshake. Use synthetic details only.

## Human authorization and agent involvement

Describe authorized scope without publishing private information.

## Expected and observed behavior

Include versions and a minimal reproduction. Never include private keys or credentials.

## Security implications

Key possession is not real-world identity verification. Do not publish an active exploit or sensitive data.
